prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1332; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm you're okay to continue?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened on the day of the collision.

A: I was driving in the right lane on the highway in Katy, heading toward the interchange. I wanted to move over to the left lane because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror, saw nothing right beside me, and started to change lanes. Then I heard a horn and felt a bump on the side of my car. The other vehicle had come up in my blind spot.

Q: Did you signal before you changed lanes?

A: Yes, I put my turn signal on for a few seconds before I moved over.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before contact?

A: Not until right at the moment of impact. I glanced at my mirror but I didn't see it in time.

Q: Where did the vehicles make contact?

A: Their front corner hit my rear passenger side door and quarter panel.

Q: You mentioned an injury. Can you tell me about that?

A: My right knee hit the dashboard and the console. It swelled up quickly, and I had trouble bending it that evening. I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and they took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment for the knee?

A: Yes, I have a physical therapy appointment twice a week, and I'm still using a brace when I walk for long periods.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car fixed and my knee taken care of.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the recorded statement.
